page.每一节都配了一段动画，跟着做一遍就会。点任意一步，动画就跳到那里；看不清就点「慢: Every section comes with a short animation. Follow along once and you've got it. Click any step to jump there in the animation, or click “Slow” if it moves too fast.

page.打开 PecoFence，桌面上的图标会自动分好类。: Start PecoFence and your desktop icons are sorted for you.
page.打开 PecoFence，从开始菜单或桌面快捷方式打开都行。: Start PecoFence from the Start menu or a desktop shortcut.
page.第一次打开时，它会在屏幕右边建好四个栅栏，把桌面图标按类型放进去。: The first time, it creates four fences on the right side of the screen and puts your desktop icons into them by type.
page.以后桌面上有了新文件，也会自动放进对应的栅栏。: New files that show up on the desktop later go into the matching fence automatically.
page.想恢复原样，就右键托盘图标（任务栏右下角的 PecoFence 图标，没看到就先: To get your old desktop back, right-click the tray icon (the PecoFence icon at the right end of the taskbar; if you don't see it, select ^ first) and select Exit PecoFence. Your files stay in your Desktop folder the whole time. PecoFence only shows them in fences.
page.分类按的是整理规则，右键托盘图标选「设置…」，在「整理规则」页就能改。规则都对不: Sorting rules decide which fence each icon goes to. To change them, right-click the tray icon, select “Settings…” and open the “Sorting rules” page. Files that match no rule go to the “Desktop” fence.
page.想把一类图标单独放在一起，就给它们新建一个栅栏。: Want to keep a group of icons together? Give them a fence of their own.
page.在桌面空白处按住鼠标，拖出一个框。框不要碰到已有的栅栏。: Press and hold on an empty part of the desktop and drag out a box. Don't let the box touch an existing fence.
page.松开鼠标，点<b>「在此新建栅栏」</b>。: Release the mouse button and select Create a fence here.
page.把图标拖进新栅栏。: Drag icons into the new fence.
page.右键标题栏，选<b>「重命名…」</b>，输入名字后按 <kbd>Enter</: Right-click the title bar, select Rename, type a name and press Enter.
page.也可以右键某个栅栏的标题栏，选「新建栅栏」，新栅栏会放在它旁边的空位上。托盘菜单: You can also right-click a fence's title bar and select “New fence”. The new fence goes into a free spot next to it. The tray menu has this command too.
page.栅栏想放哪就拖到哪，大小也能随时改。靠近别的栅栏时会自动对齐。: Drag a fence wherever you like and resize it anytime. It lines up with other fences when you bring it close.
page.按住标题栏拖动，栅栏就跟着走。靠近别的栅栏或屏幕边缘时会自动对齐，边对齐时会显示: Drag the title bar and the fence follows. Near another fence or the edge of the screen it snaps into line, and a guide shows which edges line up. Don't drop it on another fence's title bar, or the two fences merge into tabs.
page.把鼠标移到栅栏边缘，光标变成双箭头后拖动，就能改大小。这条边也会自动对齐。: Point to the edge of a fence. When the pointer turns into a double arrow, drag to resize. The edge snaps into line too.
page.拖动任意一个角，宽和高一起改，图标会自动重新排列。: Drag a corner to change the width and height together. The icons rearrange themselves.
page.拖动时按住 <kbd>Alt</kbd> 就不会自动对齐。怕不小心拖乱，可以右键: Hold <kbd>Alt</kbd> while dragging to turn off snapping. To keep a fence from being moved by accident, right-click its title bar and select “Lock position and size”.
page.暂时用不到的栅栏可以收起来，只留标题栏。鼠标停一下，它就展开。: Roll up a fence you don't need right now, so only its title bar is left. Rest the pointer on it and it expands.
page.双击标题栏，栅栏就收起来，只剩标题栏，上面会显示里面有几项。: Double-click the title bar. The fence rolls up to just its title bar, which shows how many items are inside.
page.鼠标在收起的标题栏上停一下，它会自动展开；移开就又收起来。: Rest the pointer on a rolled-up title bar and the fence expands. Move away and it rolls up again.
page.想让它一直展开，点标题栏右边的箭头，或者再双击一次标题栏。: To keep it open, click the arrow at the right end of the title bar, or double-click the title bar again.
page.不想鼠标一停就展开，可以在「设置」→「常规」里打开「收起的栅栏需点击标题才展开」: If you'd rather it didn't expand on hover, turn on “Require a click to expand rolled-up fences” in “Settings” → “General”. A fence then expands only when you click its title bar. Dragging a file over a rolled-up title bar also expands it, so you can drop the file in.
page.把想要的效果告诉 AI 助手，它会用 PecoFence 自带的命令行工具 pe: Tell an AI agent what you want, and it makes the changes with pecofence-cli, the command-line tool that comes with PecoFence.
page.打开 PecoFence，再打开你的 AI 编程助手（Claude Code、C: Start PecoFence, then open your AI coding agent (Claude Code, Codex and Cursor all work) and send it your request.
page.按这段话，助手会先运行 <code>pecofence-cli skill</c: Following this request, the agent first runs pecofence-cli skill and pecofence-cli describe to learn how the tool works. Then it checks your current configuration and backs it up before changing anything.
page.接着它运行命令修改配置。每改一项，桌面上的栅栏马上跟着变。: Next it runs commands to change the configuration. Your fences update on the desktop with each change.
page.先阅读 pecofence-cli skill 和 pecofence-cli: First read pecofence-cli skill and pecofence-cli describe. Check and back up my configuration, then switch to dark mode and make all fences more transparent.
page.Microsoft Store 版装好就能直接用 <code>pecofence: With the Microsoft Store edition, pecofence-cli works right after installation. With the installer or portable edition, give the agent the full path to pecofence-cli.exe: the installer puts it in %LOCALAPPDATA%\Programs\PecoFence by default, and the portable edition keeps it in the folder you extracted.
page.把图标拖进另一个栅栏，它就显示在那里。在普通栅栏之间拖来拖去，文件本身不动。: Drag an icon into another fence and it shows up there. Between regular fences, the file itself stays where it is.
page.按住图标，拖进另一个栅栏再松开。目标栅栏会亮起来，并提示「移动到 工作」。要是提: Drag an icon into another fence and release it. The target fence lights up and says “Move to Work”. If the hint names a folder instead, the file really moves into that folder when you release it.
page.想一次移好几个，先按住 <kbd>Ctrl</kbd> 逐个点选，或者在栅栏空白: To move several icons at once, hold <kbd>Ctrl</kbd> and click each one, or drag a box around them in an empty part of the fence. Then drag them together.
page.拖到桌面空白处松开，图标会按整理规则重新归类。没有对应规则的，会放进「桌面」栅栏: Drop an icon on an empty part of the desktop and the sorting rules place it again. If no rule matches, it goes to the “Desktop” fence.
page.不想拖，也可以右键图标，在「移动到栅栏」里选一个栅栏。: Rather not drag? Right-click the icon and pick a fence under “Move to fence”.
page.每个栅栏都可以单独设置图标大小、排列顺序和显示方式。: Each fence has its own icon size, sort order and view.
page.鼠标放在栅栏里，按住 <kbd>Ctrl</kbd> 滚动滚轮，图标就会变大或变: With the pointer over a fence, hold <kbd>Ctrl</kbd> and turn the mouse wheel. The icons get bigger or smaller, and the fence's height adjusts. This works only in the “Icons” view.
page.右键标题栏，在<b>「排序方式」</b>里选一种，比如<b>「按类型」</b>。: Right-click the title bar and pick an order under Sort by, such as Type. The icons slide to their new places.
page.在<b>「视图」</b>里可以换成<b>「列表」</b>或<b>「详细信息」</: Under View, you can switch to List or Details. Details shows the date modified, type and size.
page.「视图」菜单里也能直接选图标大小。在详细信息视图里，点列标题就能按这一列排序，再: You can also pick an icon size from the “View” menu. In Details view, click a column header to sort by that column, and click it again to reverse the order.
page.加一条规则，以后新文件就会自动放进你指定的栅栏。: Add a rule and new files go straight to the fence you choose.
page.打开「设置」→「整理规则」（右键托盘图标，选<b>「设置…」</b>），展开<b: Open “Settings” → “Sorting rules” (right-click the tray icon and select Settings…), then expand New rule. Enter “Invoice” as the “Rule name”, set “Condition type” to Name contains, and enter “Invoice” as the “Condition value” too.
page.「目标栅栏」选「报销」（这里只列出已有的栅栏），点<b>「添加规则」</b>。再: Set “Target fence” to “Expenses” (only existing fences are listed) and select Add rule. Then select Move up to put the rule above “Files and documents”. Otherwise invoices would go to “Files and documents” first.
page.以后桌面上出现名字带「发票」的文件，就会自动进「报销」。: From now on, any new file on the desktop with “Invoice” in its name goes straight to “Expenses”.
page.桌面上原有的图标不会自己挪。点<b>「立即应用」</b>，它们也会按规则重新放好: Icons already on the desktop don't move on their own. Select Apply now to sort them by the rules too. Icons you placed by hand stay put.
page.托盘菜单里的「立即应用整理规则」效果一样。想一步建好栅栏和规则，可以用「快速添加: “Apply sorting rules now” in the tray menu does the same. To create a fence and its rule in one go, use the buttons under “Quick add”.
page.几个栅栏可以合成一个，像浏览器的标签页一样来回切换。: Combine several fences into one and switch between them like browser tabs.
page.按住一个栅栏的标题栏，拖到另一个栅栏的标题栏上，那条标题栏会亮起来。: Drag a fence by its title bar onto another fence's title bar. That title bar lights up.
page.松开鼠标，两个栅栏就合成了一个。拖过来的那个变成新标签页，并且直接显示出来。: Release the mouse button and the two fences become one. The fence you dragged becomes a new tab and opens right away.
page.点标签就能切换。点过这个栅栏以后，也可以按 <kbd>Ctrl</kbd>+<k: Click a tab to switch to it. Once you've clicked in the fence, you can also press <kbd>Ctrl</kbd>+<kbd>Tab</kbd>.
page.想拆开，就按住标签往下拖。拖出标题栏后，它又变回单独的栅栏，拖到桌面空白处松开就: To split them up again, drag a tab down. Once it leaves the title bar, it's a separate fence again. Drop it on an empty part of the desktop.
page.把图标拖到某个标签上，它就直接放进那一页。右键标题栏或标签，「标签页」里也有「合: Drop an icon on a tab to put it straight into that tab. Right-click the title bar or a tab to find “Merge into” and “Detach into its own fence” under “Tabs”.
page.想看看壁纸，或者截一张干净的桌面，双击一下桌面空白处就行。: Want to see your wallpaper or take a clean screenshot? Just double-click an empty part of the desktop.
page.在桌面空白处双击，栅栏就都藏起来了。: Double-click an empty part of the desktop and all your fences disappear.
page.设了<b>「双击桌面隐藏时保留此栅栏」</b>的栅栏会留在桌面上，比如这里的「常: Fences with Stay visible when fences are hidden turned on stay on the desktop, like “Favorites” here. This switch is in Fence options… on the fence's menu.
page.再双击一次，栅栏就回来了。: Double-click again and the fences come back.
page.也可以右键托盘图标（任务栏右下角的 PecoFence 图标），选<b>「隐藏所: You can also right-click the tray icon (the PecoFence icon at the right end of the taskbar) and select Hide all fences.
page.隐藏以后，托盘菜单里这一项会变成「显示所有栅栏」。不想双击桌面时隐藏，可以在「设: While fences are hidden, this tray menu item reads “Show all fences”. If you don't want a double-click to hide fences, turn off “Double-click the desktop to hide or show fences” in “Settings” → “General”.
page.窗口挡住桌面时，按一下快捷键，栅栏就浮到最上面，不用把窗口最小化。: When windows cover the desktop, press a shortcut to bring your fences to the front. No need to minimize anything.
page.按 <kbd>Ctrl</kbd>+<kbd>Alt</kbd>+<kbd>空格: Press <kbd>Ctrl</kbd>+<kbd>Alt</kbd>+<kbd>Space</kbd>. All fences float above your windows and everything else dims.
page.看完了，再按一次快捷键，或者点一下栅栏外面的地方，栅栏就回到窗口下面。还没点过栅: When you're done, press the shortcut again or click outside the fences, and they go back behind the windows. If you haven't clicked a fence yet, <kbd>Esc</kbd> works too.
page.速览时可以直接双击图标打开文件。文件打开后，速览会自动结束，切到别的窗口也一样。: While peeking, double-click an icon to open the file. Peek ends once the file opens, and also when you switch to another window.
page.也可以右键托盘图标（任务栏右下角的 PecoFence 图标），选「速览所有栅栏: You can also right-click the tray icon (the PecoFence icon at the right end of the taskbar) and select “Peek at all fences”. To change the shortcut, go to “Settings” → “General” → “Peek”. There, click the shortcut box and press the keys you want.
page.在桌面显示文件夹: Show a folder on the desktop
page.把常用的文件夹放到桌面上，变成一个文件夹栅栏。文件夹里有什么，它就显示什么。: Put a folder you use a lot on the desktop as a folder fence. It shows whatever is in the folder.
page.右键栅栏里的文件夹图标，选<b>「在桌面显示此文件夹」</b>。: Right-click a folder icon in a fence and select Show this folder on the desktop.
page.旁边会多出一个栅栏，里面就是这个文件夹的内容。标题前有个小文件夹图标，表示这是文: A new fence appears next to it with the folder's contents. The small folder icon before the title marks it as a folder fence.
page.双击子文件夹，就在栅栏里打开它。点标题最左边的向上箭头，或按 <kbd>Back: Double-click a subfolder to open it inside the fence. To go back up a level, click the up arrow at the far left of the title bar or press <kbd>Backspace</kbd>.
page.把文件拖进来，文件就真的移进了这个文件夹。在普通栅栏之间拖来拖去不会挪动文件，这: Drag a file in and it really moves into the folder. That's the difference from regular fences, where dragging never moves the file.
page.托盘菜单里的「在桌面显示文件夹」可以直接选文档、下载、图片等文件夹。把文件从这里: “Show a folder on the desktop” in the tray menu lets you pick Documents, Downloads, Pictures and other folders directly. Dragging a file from a folder fence to a regular fence or the desktop moves the file to the desktop. When you no longer need the fence, right-click its title bar and select “Delete fence”. The folder and its files stay where they are.
page.可以给所有栅栏换一种风格，也可以给某个栅栏单独换颜色、调透明度。: Change the style of all fences at once, or give one fence its own color and transparency.
page.在「设置」→「常规」→「主题风格」里选 Fluent 或 Liquid Glas: In “Settings” → “General” → “Theme style”, choose Fluent or Liquid Glass. All fences change right away.
page.想单独调一个栅栏，右键它的标题栏，选<b>「栅栏选项…」</b>。: Right-click a fence's title bar and select Fence options… to adjust just that fence.
page.在<b>「色调」</b>里点一种颜色，玻璃就染上这个颜色。打开<b>「只给标题栏: Under Tint, click a color to tint the glass. Turn on Tint the title bar only to color just the title bar.
page.把<b>「标题字号」</b>调大一些。<b>「不透明度」</b>选<b>「全透明: Make the Title text size a bit larger. Set Opacity to Fully transparent, and only the icons and title show, with the tint hidden too. The glass appears when you point to the fence.
page.「标题颜色」可以选白色、黑色或跟随色调。想用深色模式，在「常规」页改「颜色模式」: “Title color” can be white, black or match the tint. For dark mode, change “Color mode” on the “General” page.
page.嫌标题栏占地方，可以让它平时藏起来，鼠标移上去再出来。: If title bars take up too much room, hide them until you point to a fence.
page.在「设置」→「常规」里往下翻到「行为」，打开<b>「鼠标悬停时才显示标题栏」</: In “Settings” → “General”, scroll down to “Behavior” and turn on Show title bar only on hover. The title bars disappear and only the icons are left.
page.鼠标移到栅栏上，标题栏就出来了，图标位置不变。移开又藏起来。: Point to a fence and its title bar comes back, while the icons stay in place. Move away and it hides again.
page.想单独设置某个栅栏，就到「栅栏」页选中它，把<b>「显示标题栏」</b>改成<b: To set this for one fence, select it on the “Fences” page and change Show title bar to Always or On hover.
page.右键标题栏，选「栅栏选项…」，可以直接打开这个栅栏的设置。栅栏收起时只剩标题栏，: Right-click a title bar and select “Fence options…” to go straight to that fence's settings. A rolled-up fence is only a title bar, so its title bar always stays visible.
page.先存一份快照，栅栏拖乱了也能一键恢复。: Save a snapshot first, and you can undo a messed-up layout in one click.
page.右键托盘图标，选<b>「设置…」</b>，打开<b>「布局与备份」</b>。: Right-click the tray icon, select Settings… and open Layout and backups.
page.给快照起个名字（也可以不填），点<b>「保存快照」</b>。: Give the snapshot a name (optional) and select Save snapshot.
page.之后栅栏怎么挪都没关系。: Now move your fences around as much as you like.
page.点快照右边的<b>「恢复」</b>，栅栏的位置、大小和里面的图标都会回到保存时的: Select Restore next to the snapshot. The fences' positions, sizes and icons go back to how they were when you saved it. A “Before snapshot restore” entry also appears in the list, in case you change your mind.
page.快照只管栅栏布局。设置和整理规则可以用「导出…」存成文件，换电脑时再「导入…」。: Snapshots cover only the fence layout. To save your settings and sorting rules to a file, use “Export…”, then “Import…” on your new PC. PecoFence also backs up your full configuration every day and keeps the last 7. Restoring a backup replaces your settings and rules as well.
page.常用的键盘和鼠标操作都在这里。用键盘之前，先点一下栅栏里的图标或空白处。: The keyboard and mouse actions you'll use most. Before you use the keyboard, click an icon or an empty spot in a fence.
page.速览：所有栅栏浮到窗口上面。再按一次，或点栅栏外面就回去: Peek: bring all fences above your windows. Press again or click outside the fences to go back
page.点一下或右键托盘图标: Click or right-click the tray icon
page.速览的快捷键可以在「设置」→「常规」→「速览栅栏」里换。: You can change the Peek shortcut in “Settings” → “General” → “Peek”.
page.隐藏所有栅栏，再双击一次显示: Hide all fences. Double-click again to show them
page.在空白处拖出一个框: Drag a box on an empty spot
page.选中框碰到的栅栏。没碰到栅栏时，松开后可以点「在此新建栅栏」: Select the fences the box touches. If it touches none, you can select “Create a fence here” when you release
page.按住 <kbd>Ctrl</kbd> 或 <kbd>Shift</kbd> 拖框: Hold <kbd>Ctrl</kbd> or <kbd>Shift</kbd> and drag a box
page.在已选的栅栏之外再加几个: Add more fences to the selection
page.按住其中一个的标题栏拖动: Drag the title bar of a selected fence
page.双击标题栏，或点右边的箭头: Double-click the title bar, or click the arrow on the right
page.右键标题栏或空白处: Right-click the title bar or an empty spot
page.改图标大小（只在「图标」视图里）: Change the icon size (“Icons” view only)
page.把复制的文件粘贴进来: Paste copied files into the fence
page.把标题栏拖到另一个栅栏的标题栏上: Drag a title bar onto another fence's title bar
page.在标题栏上滚动滚轮: Turn the mouse wheel over the title bar
page.切换到上一个或下一个标签页: Go to the previous or next tab
page.左右拖动标签: Drag a tab left or right
page.把标签拖出标题栏: Drag a tab out of the title bar
page.按这一列排序，再点一次倒过来: Sort by that column. Click again to reverse
page.拖列标题之间的分隔线: Drag the divider between column headers
page.改列宽，双击就自动调到合适的宽度: Change the column width. Double-click to fit the contents
page.移动或调整栅栏时: While moving or resizing a fence
page.取消，栅栏回到原位。拖标签时也一样: Cancel and put the fence back. Works when dragging a tab too
page.多选，再点一次取消这一个: Add to the selection. Click again to remove it
page.在栅栏空白处拖框: Drag a box in an empty part of the fence
page.框选。按住 <kbd>Shift</kbd> 追加，按住 <kbd>Ctrl</: Select the icons in the box. Hold <kbd>Shift</kbd> to add, or <kbd>Ctrl</kbd> to toggle
page.移动选择，同时按住 <kbd>Shift</kbd> 就连选: Move the selection. Hold <kbd>Shift</kbd> to extend it
page.只移动焦点框，选择不变。再按 <kbd>Ctrl</kbd>+<kbd>空格</: Move the focus without changing the selection. Press <kbd>Ctrl</kbd>+<kbd>Space</kbd> to select or deselect
page.输入名字的开头: Type the start of a name
page.<kbd>F2</kbd>，或选中后再点一下名字: <kbd>F2</kbd>, or click the name of a selected icon
page.重命名。按 <kbd>Enter</kbd> 确定，<kbd>Esc</kbd>: Rename. Press <kbd>Enter</kbd> to confirm or <kbd>Esc</kbd> to cancel
page.复制 / 剪切，在资源管理器里也能粘贴: Copy / cut. You can paste in File Explorer too

page.用 PecoFence 时大家常问的几件事。: Questions people often ask about PecoFence.
page.不会。整理规则只决定图标显示在哪个栅栏，文件一直在桌面文件夹里。会动到真实文件的: No. Sorting rules only decide which fence shows an icon. The files stay in your Desktop folder. Real files change only when you do something yourself: delete, rename or paste, drag icons into a folder or folder fence, drag files out of a folder fence, or drag files from File Explorer into a fence (they move to the desktop).
page.多半是不小心双击了桌面空白处，把栅栏隐藏了。再双击一次就回来了，也可以右键托盘图: You probably double-clicked an empty part of the desktop by accident, which hides them. Double-click again to bring them back, or right-click the tray icon (the PecoFence icon at the right end of the taskbar) and select Show all fences. If you don't need this feature, go to “Settings” → “General” and turn off Double-click the desktop to hide or show fences.
page.桌面图标全不见了怎么办？: What if all my desktop icons are gone?
page.PecoFence 运行时会隐藏 Windows 自己的桌面图标，图标都显示在栅: While PecoFence is running, it hides the regular Windows desktop icons and shows them in fences instead. If they don't come back after you exit, right-click the desktop and select View → Show desktop icons. While PecoFence is running, you can also right-click the tray icon and select Fix missing desktop icons.
page.退出或卸载以后，桌面会变成什么样？: What happens to my desktop when I exit or uninstall?
page.退出后栅栏消失，桌面图标重新显示出来，和用 PecoFence 之前一样。卸载只: When you exit, the fences go away and your desktop icons come back, just as before you used PecoFence. Uninstalling removes only the app itself; the files on your desktop aren't touched. The installer edition keeps your settings after uninstalling, while the Microsoft Store edition removes them too, so export your configuration first if you need it. The portable edition has no uninstaller: turn off Start with Windows in “Settings” → “General”, exit, and then delete the folder.
page.按 <kbd>Win</kbd>+<kbd>D</kbd> 时，栅栏会消失吗？: Do fences disappear when I press <kbd>Win</kbd>+<kbd>D</kbd>?
page.不会，栅栏默认会留在桌面上。想让它们跟着一起隐藏，到「设置」→「常规」，把<b>: No, by default fences stay on the desktop. To hide them as well, go to “Settings” → “General” and set When using Show desktop (Win+D) to Hide fences.
page.笔记本接上或拔掉外接显示器，栅栏还是那一套，只是摆放的位置不同。每换一种显示器组: When you plug in or unplug an external display on a laptop, you keep the same fences; only their positions change. PecoFence remembers a separate arrangement for each combination of displays, resolution and scaling, so everything is back in place when you return to it. To swap the fences between two displays, go to “Settings” → “Layout and backups” and select Swap.
page.新文件为什么进了「桌面」栅栏？: Why did a new file go to the “Desktop” fence?
page.新文件出现在桌面上时，PecoFence 会按整理规则给它找栅栏，一条都对不上就: When a new file appears on the desktop, PecoFence uses your sorting rules to find it a fence. If no rule matches, it goes to the “Desktop” fence. Add a rule in “Settings” → “Sorting rules” and similar files go to another fence from then on. You can also drag the icon into the fence you want; the rules won't move it again.
page.配置文件在哪？便携版呢？: Where is the configuration file? And with the portable edition?
page.打开「设置」→「关于」就能看到配置文件的位置，点<b>「打开配置文件夹」</b>: “Settings” → “About” shows where the configuration file is, and Open configuration folder opens it. It's usually in %APPDATA%\PecoFence; for the Microsoft Store edition it's in %LOCALAPPDATA%\Packages\DayuanJiang.PecoFence_0bme5nfnaj27p\LocalCache\Roaming\PecoFence. When you start the portable edition with the --portable option, it uses the config folder next to the app instead.
page.怎么备份？换电脑时怎么办？: How do I back up, or move to a new PC?
page.到「设置」→「布局与备份」，点<b>「导出…」</b>，把设置、整理规则和栅栏布: Go to “Settings” → “Layout and backups” and select Export… to save your settings, sorting rules and fence layout to one file. Then select Import… on the new PC. The files on your desktop aren't included, so copy them over yourself. PecoFence also makes a backup every day; the last 7 are listed on the same page, and Restore brings one back. Restoring a backup replaces your settings and rules too.
page.怎么设置开机启动？: How do I make PecoFence start with Windows?
page.默认就会随 Windows 启动，开关在「设置」→「常规」→<b>「随 Wind: It starts with Windows by default. The switch is in “Settings” → “General” → Start with Windows. The portable edition started with --portable doesn't set this up by itself, so turn the switch on yourself. In the Microsoft Store edition, the switch takes you to the Apps → Startup page of Windows Settings, where you turn PecoFence on or off.
page.速览的快捷键按了没反应？: Nothing happens when I press the Peek shortcut?
page.右键托盘图标，「速览所有栅栏」后面显示的就是现在能用的快捷键。你选的快捷键被系统: Right-click the tray icon: the shortcut shown next to “Peek at all fences” is the one that works right now. If Windows or another app already uses the shortcut you chose, PecoFence switches to a free one and tells you. If no shortcut is shown, Peek is turned off or every shortcut is taken; you can still select the menu item itself. The switch and the shortcut are in “Settings” → “General” → Peek. The shortcut box there also shows the one that works right now; to pick another, click it and press the new keys.
page.遇到问题怎么反馈？: How do I report a problem?
page.右键托盘图标，选<b>「发送反馈…」</b>，或者打开「设置」→「反馈」，写好后: Right-click the tray icon and select Send feedback…, or open “Settings” → “Feedback”. Write your message and select Send. A diagnostic log is attached by default. It contains no file names, paths or fence names, and you can check it first with View what will be sent.
